200
Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management successfully validated the verification code and
enabled two-factor authentication.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
any
— 400
Returned if your request specified invalid parameters, if your request was improperly formatted, or if
the verification code was empty, incorrect, or expired.
— 404 Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management cannot find the specified user.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
